title: Fix three bugs in Go CSV util: off-by-one, nil check, wrong file mode
description: The go_csv_reader csvutil package has three injected bugs: CountRows returns wrong count, FilterCSV panics on empty CSV, and WriteCSV uses wrong file permissions. Fix all three so the tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in internal/csvutil/csvutil.go:

1. CountRows: currently returns len(records) instead of len(records)-1 — fix to exclude the header row

2. FilterCSV: panics on empty CSV because it accesses records[0] without checking if records is empty — fix with an early return for empty input

3. WriteCSV: uses file permission 0o444 (read-only) which causes WriteFile to fail on re-runs — fix to use 0o644

All 4 existing tests in internal/csvutil/csvutil_test.go must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: FilterCSV returns empty slice for empty CSV (no panic)
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
